name: Méhtelek (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Méhtelek: a quartered blue and yellow shield with a church, a bough, a beehive and a wavy stripe, above a scroll inscribed MÉHTELEK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
